QuestInfo.name: A Torn Letter
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p412# of #m10003004# has yet another favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: #p412# of #m10003004# said she simply couldn't bring herself to change her own bandages, and asked me to go find Dr. Niora. She said she'd found part of a letter #p425# had sent to Dr. Niora, and thought #p425# might know something about her whereabouts. I should go see #b#p425##k at #b#m10003007##k. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I met #p425# at #m10003007#. She clearly seems to know something.

0.0: Ngh... nngh... it's no use. I just can't bring myself to change the bandages myself. Hic... hic... What am I supposed to do? Am I really going to be stuck in this hospital forever? I can't accept that! There's still so much I want to do!
0.1: Ah... come to think of it, I found a torn-up letter here at the hospital. It was ripped to shreds so I couldn't make out what it said, but I could tell it was a letter someone named #b#p425##k had sent to Dr. Niora. Would you mind finding that person and asking them where Dr. Niora might be?

yes.0: Thank you so much. Oh, that's right, that person once asked you to check in on how I was doing, didn't they? I'm sure they must know something. I'm counting on you, then!

no.0: Ah... I never thought you could be so cold-hearted.

1.0: Oh, #h0#, what brings you here today? Hm? #p412# at #m10003004# wants to know where Dr. Niora went? Ah, ahaha... Why would I know anything about someone like that?
1.1: Wait... you found part of a letter I sent to Dr. Niora...? Hmph... I see... Guess there's no use playing dumb anymore.

npc.0: Please, I really need to know where Dr. Niora went. Ask that person named #b#p425##k where Dr. Niora went. Please, I'm begging you...!
